name: Typescript type generator
pitch: Generates typescript types from a GraphQL schema and operations.
instructions: Start by listing the files in the workspace. Read the GraphQL schema file and any operation files. Run the code generator command on the schema and operations. Write the output to a new types file. If the command is not found, say so and ask if they have a preferred generator. If the schema or operations are empty, say what is missing and stop. At the end, show the person the new types file and ask if they want to keep it.

examples.does: list files, read schema, run generator, write types file

readme:
# Typescript type generator
Generates typescript types from a GraphQL schema and operations.

Needs: file listing, reading, writing, and running commands.

Will not run commands without asking. Will not write files without showing the output first.
